title: Iran declares the Strait of Hormuz 'completely open' amid fragile ceasefire
summary: Iran says the Strait of Hormuz is open to commercial shipping during the Lebanon ceasefire, triggering a sharp drop in oil prices, while Donald Trump welcomed the move but kept a US naval blockade in place.
